pages.lesson:
LESSON: PLAY SIMPLE

Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PERFORMANCE
Topic 9.3: Play simple

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Play simple. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate self and other’s performed music. ICT devices operate and store electronic gadgets

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. appreciate self and other’s performed music. ICT devices operate and store electronic gadgets
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate self and other’s performed music. ICT devices operate and store electronic gadgets. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Play simple.
2. Explain Play simple to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: You should be guided to name 1. Which game do you musical leaner should be able to: various electronic gadgets like playing? Instrument a) identify various ICT devices
4. Show that you can: appreciate self and other’s performed music. ICT devices operate and store electronic gadgets
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Play simple. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Play simple important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Be guided to name 1. Which game do you musical leaner should be able to: various electronic gadgets like playing? Instrument a) identify various ICT devices

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. appreciate self and other’s performed music. ICT devices operate and store electronic gadgets

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
